title: Austria: Austrian-based authorised representative for foreign sellers
summary: Since 1 January 2023 a company without an Austrian establishment, including online retailers selling into Austria, must appoint an Austrian-based authorised representative to hold its packaging obligations. There is no distance-selling carve-out from the underlying registration and system-participation duties.

required_evidence.label: Signed appointment of the authorised representative
